blocks.text: Mediation Studio is in development and available to order. It handles telecom mediation: it collects and cleans every usage record from the network before billing, and a ledger per file shows what the network sent and what billing received.

Revenue leaks when usage records are lost or duplicated, or get stuck. Disputed bills have no per-file evidence. Every new feed becomes a services project. Mediation Studio brings telecom mediation and revenue assurance into one product, so every record from the network can be traced through to the bill.

items.a: It collects and cleans every usage record from the network before billing.

items.q: How do we show that nothing was lost?
items.a: A balancing ledger per file shows what the network sent and what billing received. Each disputed bill has evidence behind it.

items.q: What happens to duplicate or failed records?
items.a: Duplicates are detected and dropped. Failed records are repaired and resubmitted.
**Mediation in telecom** collects usage records from network elements, converts them into one format and passes them to billing, settlement and analytics.

**Telecom revenue assurance** checks that every billable event is captured and rated, then invoiced correctly, so revenue is not lost between the network and the bill. Read: What causes revenue leakage in telecom? →

blocks.text: Mediation Studio is being built so your team installs it like every Alepo product: in containers, one standard way, from the same automated guide. Upgrades stay small.

When something needs fixing, the patch goes only to the component affected, with rollback ready, so your maintenance window stays short and nothing else has to be upgraded at the same time. Mediation Studio will run on Kubernetes in your environment, operated by your team or by Alepo, with 24x7 support from GTAC.
The build you test and see demoed is the build that goes live.
